factual_claims.claim: Gigasun reported continued operational growth in 2025, with higher electricity production, expanded solar capacity and improved operating profitability.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors’ Report: 'In 2025, the company installed a total of 55.7 (57.5) MW of roof-based solar energy facilities and had 395.8 (340.1) MW installed and revenue-generating capacity at the end of the year... Operating profit amounted to SEK 73.5 (60.7) million, an increase of 21.1 percent compared with the previous year.'

factual_claims.claim: Group revenue increased 9.8% to SEK 239.7 million from SEK 218.3 million, while net revenue from electricity sales rose 9.9% to SEK 203.2 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors’ Report: 'Revenues amounted to SEK 239.7 (218.3) million... Net revenue amounted to SEK 203.2 (184.8) million, an increase of 9.9 percent compared with the previous year.'

factual_claims.claim: Revenue growth was supported by higher production, although it was partly offset by lower average prices from a greater share of electricity sold to the grid, revised tariffs during the second half of the year and currency effects of SEK -18.0 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors’ Report: 'The increase is attributable to higher production, but is simultaneously negatively impacted by lower average prices as a result of a higher share of electricity sold to the grid, as well as revised tariffs during the second half of the year and a weaker currency. Currency effects impacted revenues by SEK -18.0 (-4.5) million.'

factual_claims.claim: Subsidies contributed SEK 32.7 million of other operating income.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 4: 'Subsidies for green electricity [Group 2025: 32,667; 2024: 32,044]' and 'Other operating income amounted to SEK 36.5 (33.5) million.'

factual_claims.claim: Gross profit increased to SEK 195.8 million from SEK 179.2 million, with the gross margin unchanged at 82%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Income Statement: 'Gross profit [Group 2025: 195,829; 2024: 179,219]' and 'Gross margin% [Group 2025: 82%; 2024: 82%].'

factual_claims.claim: EBITDA rose to SEK 163.7 million from SEK 145.8 million, lifting the EBITDA margin from 67% to 68%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Multi-year overview and Income Statement: 'EBITDA [Group 2025: 163,733; 2024: 145,760]' and 'EBITDA% [Group 2025: 68%; 2024: 67%].'

factual_claims.claim: Operating expenses increased 5.5% to SEK 166.2 million, mainly because the larger installed base resulted in higher depreciation and maintenance costs.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors’ Report: 'Operating expenses amounted to SEK 166.2 (157.6) million, an increase of 5.5 percent... The increased costs are primarily driven by a larger installed base, resulting in higher scheduled depreciation and increased maintenance of solar PV installations.'

factual_claims.claim: Despite this increase, EBIT grew 21.1% to SEK 73.5 million, and the EBIT margin improved from 28% to 31%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors’ Report: 'Operating profit amounted to SEK 73.5 (60.7) million, an increase of 21.1 percent compared with the previous year... EBIT margin% [Group 2025: 31%; 2024: 28%].'

factual_claims.claim: The net loss narrowed substantially to SEK 7.2 million from SEK 32.9 million, and earnings per share improved to negative SEK 0.13 from negative SEK 0.58.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors’ Report: 'Profit after tax amounted to SEK -7.2 (-32.9) million... Earnings per share for the period after dilution, SEK [-0.13] (-0.58).'

factual_claims.claim: Financial expenses and similar items declined to SEK 82.0 million from SEK 88.7 million, reflecting the refinancing of Chinese debt.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors’ Report: 'Interest expenses and similar profit/loss items amounted to SEK 82.0 (88.7) million... The refinancing in China with Agricultural Bank continues to reduce interest expenses.'

factual_claims.claim: Results were also affected by a negative currency difference of SEK 3.8 million and a one-off cost of SEK 3.5 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors’ Report: 'The exchange rate difference amounted to SEK -3.8 (1.8) million... Profit for the year amounted to SEK -7.2 (-32.9) million and were impacted by a non-cash currency effect of SEK -3.8 (1.8) million as well as a one-off cost of SEK 3.5 million.'

factual_claims.claim: Excluding these items, management reported profit of approximately SEK 0.1 million, compared with a loss of SEK 34.7 million in 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: CEO Comments: 'Adjusted for the currency effect and the one-off item, profit amounted to SEK 0.1 (-34.7) million, a clear improvement demonstrating that our core operations are now profitable.'

factual_claims.claim: Operationally, Gigasun installed 55.7 MW of new rooftop solar capacity, bringing total revenue-generating capacity to 395.8 MW from 340.1 MW, an increase of approximately 16%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors’ Report: 'In 2025, the company installed a total of 55.7 (57.5) MW of roof-based solar energy facilities and had 395.8 (340.1) MW installed and revenue-generating capacity at the end of the year.'

factual_claims.claim: Electricity production increased 30% to 327.8 million kWh, while 17 contracts were signed compared with 15 in the previous year.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors’ Report: 'During the year, 327.8 (252.6) million kWh were produced, reducing CO2-related emissions by approximately 161,000 (124,000) tonnes... The Company signed 17 (15) contracts representing total installed capacity of 41.7 (56.6) MW.'

factual_claims.claim: Electricity tariffs in Jiangsu and Anhui reduced realized prices per kWh by approximately 8% in the second half, with an estimated 3–4% impact on revenue from the existing portfolio.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: CEO Comments: 'During mid-2025, electricity tariffs in the Jiangsu and Anhui provinces were adjusted... These changes have now taken effect and reduced the realized price per kWh by approximately 8 percent in the second half of the year compared with the same period the previous year... We assess that the impact on our existing project portfolio is manageable and amounts to approximately a 3–4 percent reduction in revenue.'

factual_claims.claim: The company expects lower financing and construction costs to offset this pressure.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: CEO Comments: 'Structural cost improvements such as lower financing costs and lower construction costs are expected to clearly offset the lower average revenue per kWh.'

factual_claims.claim: New regulatory requirements for self-consumption and, in some cases, energy storage may increase project requirements while creating opportunities for expanded energy-storage offerings.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: CEO Comments: 'Regulatory changes from China’s National Development and Reform Commission (NDRC) require higher levels of self-consumption and, in some cases, energy storage for new solar installations. While this increases requirements, it also opens up new business opportunities... We are well positioned to expand our offering with energy storage solutions.'

factual_claims.claim: Cash flow was negative SEK 34.9 million, compared with positive SEK 68.3 million in 2024, as operating cash flow of SEK 101.1 million was more than offset by SEK 208.1 million of investment outflows.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Statement of Cash Flow: 'Cash flow from operating activities [Group 2025: 101,058; 2024: 133,785]... Cash flow from investing activities [Group 2025: -208,101; 2024: -289,625]... Cash flow for the period [Group 2025: -34,902; 2024: 68,305].'

factual_claims.claim: Interest-bearing debt declined to SEK 1.38 billion, but cash fell to SEK 45.1 million and the equity ratio weakened to 21% from 23%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Balance Sheet: 'Interest-bearing debt [Group 2025: 1,382,613; 2024: 1,483,061]' and 'Equity ratio [Group 2025: 21%; 2024: 23%]... Cash and bank balances [Group 2025: 45,149; 2024: 89,889].'

factual_claims.claim: Refinancing of approximately SEK 1.24 billion at 3.60% over ten years is underway and is expected to continue in 2026.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors’ Report: 'The company has entered into two agreements with the Chinese company Agricultural Bank Financial Leasing Co., Ltd to refinance approximately SEK 1,242 millions (CNY 880 millions)... The refinancing has begun and will continue throughout 2026.'

factual_claims.claim: However, the SEK 70.4 million SOLT4 bond, carrying 14.25% interest, is due in November 2026, and management states that failure to secure additional financing would create significant uncertainty regarding continued operations.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors’ Report and Risks section: 'The remaining bond, SOLT4, has been extended to November 8, 2026... In the event that all alternative financing options were to fail, there is a risk that the Company would be forced to significantly revise current development plans, which would have a negative impact on the Company’s development, or even pose a risk to the continued operation and survival of the Company.'
